seq.description: Monotonic DID method log sequence for this DID. seq=0 is the inception entry and MUST NOT carry prev_event_digest; every seq>0 entry MUST carry prev_event_digest equal to the previous accepted entry's head_event_digest.

operation.description: Normalized operation kind. The DID method-specific raw operation object is carried in operation_body; this field is the reducer/verifier discriminator.

prev_event_digest.description: Hash of the previous accepted key-log entry. Required for seq>0 and forbidden for seq=0.

head_event_digest.description: Self digest of this entry: canonical_digest of the entry with `proofs` and `head_event_digest` removed (canonical JSON per encoding.md §2, wire hash form per §3.1). The next accepted entry's prev_event_digest and identity receipts both reference this value. Normative byte-level definition: zh/sync/service-surface.md §3.1.3.

operation_body.description: DID method-specific raw operation object. This is not a generic JSON Patch; validation dispatches by DID method and operation kind.

proofs.description: Controller proofs over this entry. payload_digest = canonical_digest(entry without `proofs`); the detached JWS signs the canonical binding object {payload_digest, did, verification_method, created_at, domain?, audience?} defined in zh/sync/service-surface.md §3.1.3. verification_method MUST be a controller key authorized for this operation at the previous accepted entry's state; the registry host MUST NOT substitute its own key.
